name: Co-op
author: UnderRailWorks
description: Play together. The host opens a lobby from the main menu (Host New Game, or Host Saved Game with its co-op characters); others use Join a Game and take a place with a new character (made in the game's own creation) or one saved with that game. When every place is taken the game starts: walking, fighting (the whole zone together, as the game does), doors and objects, looting, trading, conversations (everyone listens), travelling as a group, and everyone gets all the XP anyone earns. Other mods can add host options and their own messages (Co-op's API).
